content: Talrand wants a dense stream of cheap instants and sorceries, and the list already has strong cantrips and two premium draw engines. It is short on counter-magic that protects Talrand, has almost no lands, and needs a way to turn a board of Drakes into a win.

data.name: Archmage Emeritus
data.reason: A second Talrand-style engine: every instant or sorcery draws a card, so the deck refuels while it builds Drakes.

evidence.synergy: A second Talrand-style engine: every instant or sorcery draws a card, so the deck refuels while it builds Drakes.

data.name: Fierce Guardianship
data.reason: A free counterspell while Talrand is on the battlefield, which protects the engine on the turn it lands.

alternatives.name: Dispel
alternatives.reason: One blue mana for the same protection against removal spells.

evidence.synergy: One blue mana for the same protection against removal spells.

alternatives.name: Force of Will
alternatives.reason: Counters anything, at any time, without mana.

evidence.synergy: Counters anything, at any time, without mana.

alternatives.name: Narset's Reversal
alternatives.reason: Copies the removal spell back at the opponent's board.

evidence.synergy: Copies the removal spell back at the opponent's board.

data.name: Swan Song
data.reason: One mana to stop a removal spell or a board wipe aimed at the Drakes.

evidence.synergy: One mana to stop a removal spell or a board wipe aimed at the Drakes.

data.name: Mystic Sanctuary
data.reason: A land that returns a spent instant or sorcery once the Islands are down.

evidence.synergy: A land that returns a spent instant or sorcery once the Islands are down.

data.name: Mind Stone
data.reason: Ramp that cycles away when the deck no longer needs mana.

evidence.synergy: Ramp that cycles away when the deck no longer needs mana.

data.name: Thousand-Year Storm
data.reason: Copies every later spell, so each one makes several Drakes with Talrand.

evidence.synergy: Copies every later spell, so each one makes several Drakes with Talrand.

data.name: Lorien Revealed
data.reason: Three cards now, or a cycled land search when the hand is full.

evidence.synergy: Three cards now, or a cycled land search when the hand is full.

data.name: Talrand's Insight
data.reason: Scry and draw at instant speed to keep the spell count up.

evidence.synergy: Scry and draw at instant speed to keep the spell count up.

data.name: Arcane Signet
data.reason: In a mono-blue deck Mind Stone does the same job and cycles later.

data.name: Murmuring Mystic
data.reason: A third payoff the deck cannot protect; the slot is better spent on protection.

data.name: Mystic Remora
data.reason: Its upkeep cost slows the deck down in long games at bracket 3.

data.name: Opt
data.reason: The weakest cantrip once Brainstorm, Ponder and Preordain are in.
